job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP for real estate investment consultant services?
job.acceptance: March 20, 2017, 4:30 p.m. HST or explicit equivalent timezone conversion.

reviews.reason: The document is an August 2021 RFP issued by Orange County Employees Retirement System, not the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP. Its proposal deadline therefore does not support the deadline requested.
quotes: Issued August 2021 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
Those who wish to be considered must submit their completed proposal, via email to the Point of Contact, by 5:00 p.m., PT, October 1, 2021.
